risks.title: General economic conditions impacting IT spending
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned first in the key factors affecting financial performance (Item 7). The language emphasizes persistent uncertainty in global trade policies, inflationary pressures, and impact on customers' technology investment decisions. This risk is stable compared to the prior year.

risks.title: Changes in public spending policies
risks.score_rationale: Described as a key factor influencing purchasing levels from government, education, and healthcare customers (Item 7). Uncertainty regarding budgetary priorities, funding levels, and potential U.S. government shutdowns is explicitly noted as potentially negatively affecting IT spending. This risk is stable.

risks.title: Rapid evolution of technology trends
risks.score_rationale: Identified as a key driver of customer buying behavior (Item 7). The rapid shift toward cloud, AI, software-defined architectures, and 'as-a-service' consumption models requires continuous adaptation. The language indicates customers will prioritize spending that delivers the greatest outcomes, implying risk if CDW is not aligned. This risk is stable.

risks.title: Cybersecurity risks
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned in the first paragraph of Item 1A, with the Audit Committee responsible for oversight. The CTO and CISO provide regular reports on security strategy, risks, and threats. Critical incidents require prompt reporting to the board. Severity is high due to the sensitive nature of data processed. This risk is stable.

risks.title: Dependence on technology partners (suppliers)
risks.score_rationale: Describes CDW's relationship as a sales partner for many OEMs, software publishers, and cloud providers (Item 7). Agreements with these partners define terms and conditions and may include discretionary rebate programs. Deterioration in relationships or terms could impact margins or product availability. This risk is stable.

risks.title: Commercial disputes and other legal proceedings
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in Item 3, indicating the company is party to various legal proceedings arising from normal operations, including commercial disputes, intellectual property, employment, and liability claims. While common, such litigation may result in significant costs and distractions. This risk is stable.

ai_positioning.summary: CDW recognizes AI as a key element of future technology trends and integrates it into its overall solution offering strategy. The document states that AI is a key technology driving demand and that CDW orchestrates solutions leveraging AI alongside security, software, and hybrid/cloud offerings.
evidence: Item 1. Business: 'demand for IT will outpace general economic growth in the markets we serve, fueled by new technologies, including hybrid and cloud computing and artificial intelligence (AI)'
Item 7. MD&A: 'We have orchestrated solutions that leverage security, software, artificial intelligence (AI), and hybrid and cloud offerings to help customers achieve their objectives'
Item 7. MD&A: 'Technology trends are focused on delivering greater flexibility and efficiency... These trends are driving customer adoption of cloud, AI, software defined architectures'
